TOR_002.title: Jethro's Counsel at Mount Sinai (Exodus 18)
TOR_002.context: Thousands of Israelites wait from morning until evening for you to judge every dispute personally.
TOR_002.prompt: How do you structure covenant governance so neither you nor the people wear out?

options.text: Appoint capable, God-fearing leaders over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens

outcomes.text: Exodus 18:21 honored: justice flows swiftly across every tribe (+35 Wisdom Score).
Elders trained in Torah statutes; minor appeals still reach your tent (+20 Score).

options.text: Refuse delegation and judge every case alone to retain total control

outcomes.text: Exhaustion stalls camp logistics and delays tabernacle assembly (-10 Score).
You endure the workload temporarily, though elders remain untrained (+5 Score).

TOR_003.title: The Year of Jubilee & Land Restoration (Leviticus 25)
TOR_003.context: The 50th year trumpet sounds across the Promised Land while debt-burdened families await ancestral restoration.
TOR_003.prompt: What royal decree do you proclaim across the gates of Israel?

options.text: Proclaim liberty throughout the land and return every family to its inheritance

outcomes.text: Leviticus 25:10 fulfilled: generational poverty broken and sixth-year harvest overflows (+40 Score).
Merchants grumble briefly, then prosper under divine blessing (+25 Score).

options.text: Delay Jubilee land returns to maximize royal tax revenue

outcomes.text: Covenant breach weakens tribal unity and triggers drought warnings (-15 Score).

HIS_002.title: Gideon's 300 at the Spring of Harod (Judges 7)
HIS_002.context: Midianite forces fill the valley like locusts while 32,000 Israelite warriors assemble behind you.
HIS_002.prompt: The Lord warns that too many troops will boast in their own strength. How do you proceed?

options.text: Test the army at the water and march at night with 300 men bearing trumpets and torches

outcomes.text: Judges 7:20 victory: Midian panics at the shattered jars and blaring trumpets (+45 Score).
The 300 hold the ridge in total discipline as enemy ranks scatter (+25 Score).

options.text: Keep all 32,000 troops for a conventional frontal assault

outcomes.text: Divided ranks falter without divine mandate (-15 Score).

HIS_003.title: Nehemiah's Wall Builders with Trowel & Sword (Nehemiah 4)
HIS_003.context: Sanballat and Tobiah threaten a surprise raid while Jerusalem's walls are only half-built.
HIS_003.prompt: How do you defend the builders without halting restoration of the city?

options.text: Post family guards by the breaches and arm every builder with one hand on the work and one on a weapon

outcomes.text: Nehemiah 4:17 triumph: the wall is completed in 52 days while enemies stand down (+40 Score).
Trumpet rally drills deter every night ambush (+25 Score).

options.text: Suspend wall construction indefinitely to negotiate with Sanballat on the plain of Ono

outcomes.text: Four distraction summits waste precious weeks while gates remain unhung (-15 Score).

WIS_002.title: Storehouse Preparation of the Ant (Proverbs 6 & 30)
WIS_002.context: Seven years of bumper grain harvests fill your granaries while court advisors urge lavish spending.
WIS_002.prompt: What treasury policy do you enact before winter and lean seasons arrive?

options.text: Seal 20% of every harvest in fortified granaries and diversify fields (Ecclesiastes 11:2)

outcomes.text: Proverbs 6:8 wisdom: surrounding nations buy grain from your full storehouses (+35 Score).
Zero famine casualties across your entire dynasty (+20 Score).

options.text: Liquidated grain reserves for luxury monuments

outcomes.text: Early frost leaves the city dependent on foreign imports (-15 Score).

PRO_002.title: King Josiah & the Discovered Book of the Law (2 Kings 22)
PRO_002.context: High Priest Hilkiah brings you the long-lost Book of the Law discovered during Temple repairs.
PRO_002.prompt: As Shaphan reads the covenant warnings aloud, how do you lead the nation?

options.text: Tear your robes in repentance, gather all elders and citizens, and renew the Covenant publicly

outcomes.text: 2 Kings 23:3 revival: idolatry purged and the greatest Passover since the Judges celebrated (+45 Score).
Temple scrolls copied and distributed to every Levite teacher (+30 Score).

options.text: Archive the scroll quietly in the royal library without public reform

outcomes.text: Unrepented corruption accelerates national decline (-20 Score).

GOS_002.title: House Built on the Rock vs. Shifting Sand (Matthew 7:24?27)
GOS_002.context: Two master builders prepare foundations before the winter rains, rising floods, and mountain winds strike.
GOS_002.prompt: Which blueprint governs your dynasty's laws, households, and leadership?

options.text: Dig deep and anchor every decree on hearing and practicing Christ's words

outcomes.text: Matthew 7:25: the storm beats fiercely against the house, yet it stands unshaken (+45 Score).
Enduring generational stability anchored in truth (+30 Score).

options.text: Build rapidly on surface popularity without obedience

outcomes.text: The first crisis washes away hollow structures (-20 Score).

EPI_002.title: The Berean Standard of Daily Scripture Verification (Acts 17:11)
EPI_002.context: New teachers arrive in your assembly proclaiming bold doctrines that stir debate among the elders.
EPI_002.prompt: How does your leadership verify every message before adopting it?

options.text: Receive the word with eagerness while examining the Scriptures daily to verify if these things are so

outcomes.text: Acts 17:11: false doctrine exposed immediately and the assembly grows in grounded faith (+45 Score).
Elders united around verified apostolic teaching (+30 Score).

options.text: Accept persuasive rhetoric without checking Scripture

outcomes.text: Conflicting factions splinter the assembly (-15 Score).

scripture_trials.prompt: How does Deuteronomy 6 command parents and leaders to pass covenant truth to the next generation?
options: Teach them diligently to your children when sitting, walking, lying down, and rising
Restrict all reading of the Law to once every ten years
Keep the commandments hidden inside sealed vaults
Rely solely on oral rumors without written record
scripture_trials.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:7 embeds Scripture into daily household rhythm across generations.

scripture_trials.prompt: When Samuel anoints David in Bethlehem, what standard distinguishes God's evaluation from human judgment?
options: Man looks on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart
Height and armor weight determine royal authority
The eldest brother always inherits the throne
Wealth of flocks outweighs faithfulness
scripture_trials.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:7 establishes heart-level integrity as the foundation of true kingship.

scripture_trials.prompt: According to Proverbs 9:10, what is the true beginning of wisdom?
options: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is insight
Accumulating gold and diplomatic treaties
Winning debates in the city gate
Mastering astronomy alone
scripture_trials.explanation: Reverent awe and obedience toward God is the root of all biblical wisdom.

scripture_trials.prompt: What three covenant requirements does Micah 6:8 declare the Lord requires of every ruler and citizen?
options: To do justice, to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God
To offer ten thousand rivers of oil
To conquer neighboring empires by force
To build taller palaces of cedar
scripture_trials.explanation: Micah 6:8 summarizes prophetic ethics: justice, covenant mercy (hesed), and humble obedience.

scripture_trials.prompt: In the Parable of the Talents, what commends the faithful steward to greater responsibility?
options: Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a little; I will set you over much
Burying the talent safely in the ground to avoid all risk
Spending the master's silver on personal feasts
Delegating all stewardship to strangers
scripture_trials.explanation: Faithful multiplication of entrusted gifts unlocks greater kingdom authority.

scripture_trials.prompt: In the Armor of God, what are the Shield of Faith and the Sword of the Spirit?
options: Faith extinguishes all flaming darts of the evil one, and the Sword of the Spirit is the Word of God
Physical bronze shields forged in Ephesus
Political alliances with Roman governors
Philosophical rhetoric from Athens
scripture_trials.explanation: Ephesians 6:16?17 equips believers with active faith and the spoken/written Word of God.
